meta.name: wiki-query
meta.description: Use when asking a question about the codebase, looking up a concept, or synthesizing an answer from the wiki + ref/ docs. Triggers: 'what do I know about X', 'look up Y', 'find in wiki', 'search docs', 'wiki says'. Read-only — defers writing to knowledge-capture.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 问代码库问题,自动从文档中找到答案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常在开发时需翻阅项目文档找答案。
copy.tagline_en: Ask questions about your codebase and get answers from project docs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often search project documentation to answer coding questions.

howto.what: 回答问题时,Claude 会先读 wiki 索引并在 docs/wiki 中搜索,综合多条匹配内容作答,给每条结论加引用链接;找不到就明说,不凭记忆编造。全程只读,不写入文件,末尾会提示用 @knowledge-capture 保存。
howto.when: 当被问到项目概念、需要查资料并从 wiki/ref 文档综合回答时触发,例如“查一下 X”“在 wiki 里找”“搜文档”。代码问题、近期变更、写操作不触发。

say.text: 在 wiki 里查一下 banker's rounding 是什么
say.note: 会搜索相关文档并带引用回答。

say.text: 找一下 NZS 3910 在 ref 文档里的相关内容
say.note: 会优先匹配 ref/ 参考文档。

say.text: wiki 上对价格拆分有哪些说明?
say.note: 会检索 wiki 并综合多条文档作答。

howto.what_en: Claude reads the wiki index, searches docs/wiki, synthesises matched docs, and cites each claim with a link. If no doc matches, it says so — no fabrication. Read-only; never writes to disk.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about a project concept, needs a lookup, or wants an answer synthesised from wiki/ref docs — e.g. 'look up Y', 'find in wiki'. Code questions, recent changes, and write actions are out of scope.

say_en.text: Look up banker's rounding in the wiki
say_en.note: Searches the wiki and answers with citations.

say_en.text: Find NZS 3910 in the ref docs
say_en.note: Prefers ref/ reference docs for topic matches.

say_en.text: What does the wiki say about price breakdown?
